claim: To set up origin failover, you must have a distribution with at least two origins; next you create an origin group that includes two origins, with one set as the primary, and finally you create or update a cache behavior to use the origin group.

evidence.quote: To set up origin failover, you must have a distribution with at least two origins.
Next, you create an origin group for your distribution that includes two origins, setting one as the primary.
Finally, you create or update a cache behavior to use the origin group.
